Decision ledger of a lab, a result or a scorecard

Source: R/classing.R
scr_decisions.Rd

Decision ledger of a lab, a result or a scorecard

Usage

scr_decisions(x)

Arguments

x

An scr_classing lab, an scr_result from scr_classing_apply() or an scr_scorecard fitted on one.

Value

A data.table, one row per decision (append-only), or an empty one when no manual decision exists.

See also

Other classing: scr_classing_accept(), scr_classing_apply(), scr_classing_choose(), scr_classing_propose(), scr_classing_spec(), scr_classing_view(), scr_coarse_classing()
